response.sql:
WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT
    f.orderslink,
    u.acctscope,
    AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
above_mean AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    acctscope,
    avg_fee_rate,
    avg_fee_rate - AVG(avg_fee_rate) OVER () AS excess
  FROM pair_averages
  WHERE avg_fee_rate > (SELECT AVG(avg_fee_rate) FROM pair_averages)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    acctscope,
    avg_fee_rate,
    excess,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rank
  FROM above_mean
)
SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_fee_rate, excess, rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY acctscope, rank, orderslink;

assumptions.assumption: The mean of all pair averages is the unweighted arithmetic mean across the distinct orderslink/account-scope pairs produced by the specified joins; pairs with a NULL average fee rate are excluded from that mean.
